description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Regression

What if we just went backwards, like really fast? When you use Regression, you no longer provoke opportunity attacks during your regressing movement. Additionally, you can instead spend up to your proficiency bonus in cursed energy. If you spend more than 1 CE, you gain a +1 bonus to the DC or Cursed Energy check per Cursed Energy spent. At 11th level, you can push creatures Huge or smaller out of your path.
